name: io.github.eshcodez/ethos-engine
title: Ethos Engine
description: Check a brand's authority signals for Google and AI search, and search a press publication network.

tools.name: check_brand_authority
tools.description: Checks the public signals that search engines and AI assistants use to decide whether a brand is credible: structured data on the brand's homepage, a Wikidata entry and Wikipedia article tied to the brand's website, press articles in the last 12 months, and (when available) what Google shows for the brand name. Use when someone asks how their brand or business shows up online, why AI assistants or Google do not mention them, or what is missing from their online authority. Returns each check with pass or fail and the evidence. Results are cached for 24 hours per brand.

website.description: The brand's website domain or URL, for example "acme.com".

brand_name.description: The name buyers search for, for example "Acme Coaching".

tools.name: search_publications
tools.description: Searches the Ethos Engine network of publications available for press placements. Filter by name or topic, country, minimum domain authority and AI-confidence rating (how often AI engines cite the outlet). Returns each publication's name, domain, domain authority (DA), DR, country, typical turnaround, AI-confidence rating and whether articles carry a sponsored label. Prices are not included.

query.description: Words to match in the publication name, domain or category, for example "tech" or "forbes".

country.description: Country to filter by, for example "United States", "US" or "United Kingdom".

min_domain_authority.description: Only publications with at least this domain authority.

ai_confidence.description: Only publications with this AI-confidence rating.

sort_by.description: Sort order. Defaults to highest domain authority first.

limit.description: How many results to return (1 to 25, default 10).

tools.name: get_score_methodology
tools.description: Returns how the Ethos Engine Digital Authority Score is calculated: its five pillars, their weights, what each pillar measures and the data sources behind it. Use when someone asks how the score or the full report works.

tools.name: get_call_booking_link
tools.description: Returns the link to apply for a call with Ethos Engine, what the application involves, and contact details. Use when someone asks to talk to Ethos Engine, book a call, or get a quote for placements.

tools.name: request_full_report
tools.description: Sends the person's email address, website and brand name to Ethos Engine so the founder can follow up by email about the full Digital Authority Report (AI visibility across ChatGPT, Perplexity and Google, competitors, and the gaps to close). Only use after the person has asked for the full report or to be contacted, and has given the email address to use. Set consent to true only when they have agreed to be emailed. Returns what happens next and a link to run the report themselves.

email.description: The email address the person wants to be contacted at.

website.description: The brand's website domain or URL, for example "acme.com".

brand_name.description: The brand name, for example "Acme Coaching".

name.description: The person's name, if they gave it.

note.description: Optional context from the person, for example what they want help with (up to 300 characters).

consent.description: True when the person has agreed to be emailed by Ethos Engine about the report.
